name: Iriso Electronics Co., Ltd.
summary: Iriso Electronics Co., Ltd. develops, manufactures, develops, and sells multi-pin connectors for automotive (in-vehicle) equipment, digital equipment, and industrial equipment in Japan, the rest of Asia, Europe, and North America. The company offers board-to-board, FPC/FFC, wire harness, socket, pin header, input/output, and card edge connectors; compression terminals for cable connections, interface connectors, and signal connections; and electrostatic discharge protector chips.
